title: Intelligent Earth (UKRI CDT in AI for the Environment)
about: Oxford's Intelligent Earth, a UKRI Centre for Doctoral Training in AI for the environment, has opened admissions for 2027 entry. The final deadline for 2027-28 entry is 12:00 midday UK time on 6 January 2027; the expected start date is 27 September 2027.
requirements: Submit at least two weeks before the deadline to be considered for January-round scholarships
Interviews expected in the second half of February

upskill.name: Domain Applications of AI I
why: "Artificial intelligence for the environment" (field) → "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold), materials science, climate modelling"

card_alt: Card for Intelligent Earth (UKRI CDT in AI for the Environment), a PhD (DPhil) programme at the University of Oxford in Oxford, United Kingdom, with an application deadline of 6 January 2027. The photo shows Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament and Westminster Bridge in London, a United Kingdom landmark rather than Oxford itself.
